findings: Synthetic feature statuses such as planned_q2, planned_q3, and in_progress read as roadmap commitments.
Roadmap output instructed acceleration and priority choices without a product-owner validation gate.

The demo video and one-pager synthesize 10,150 feedback items from four sources, rank five pain points and five feature requests, build a Q1 priority ranking, show the Q2 -> Q3 sentiment trend and draft Jira tickets; the agent had six hand-written entries, ARR-weighted requests unrelated to the video, no pain-point or ticket operation, and unexplained feature ARR weights.
fixes: Replaced commitment-like statuses with candidate_for_review and evidence_under_review.
Changed recommendations to review candidates and added no-roadmap, no-ticket, no-outreach, and no-account-action boundaries.

Aligned to the video: Q3 sources (8,500/1,200/280/170), sentiment 6,293/2,335/1,522 (7.2 from 6.8), pain_points (27/22/18/15/12% with at-risk signals), feature requests (31/24/18/14/9%), roadmap_impact as the Q1 priority ranking (P0/P0/P1/P2/P2), sentiment trend 56.1/20.9 -> 62/15, and draft_jira_tickets returning P0/P1 ticket drafts plus a draft team message; nothing is created in Jira or sent.
remaining_boundary: Production connections and all external actions require customer approval, least-privilege controls, and an authorized human workflow.
